about.what: Values of the reference package neural_eeg_features 0.6.1 at its default settings, for tests/test_neural_eeg_features_defaults.py: what this repository's NEURAL should give once it has adopted that package's default settings and conventions. Made by tests/make_reference_neural_eeg_features.py (see made_with).
about.inputs: Synthetic inputs only (tests/neural_eeg_features_inputs.py): recipe, sampling rate, duration, channels, the channel pairs given to the reference package, and the SHA-256 of each input array (neural_eeg_features_inputs.sha256).
about.config: The reference package's resolved settings, FeatureConfig().to_dict(): its defaults; per case, 'features' lists the features computed (no IBI at 256 Hz: the burst detector needs 64 Hz).
about.results: Per case and feature: 'bands' maps each output band name to its [low, high] edges in Hz (null for IBI, which has no band); 'summary' one value per band; 'per_channel' [band][channel] (not for connectivity, which compares pairs of channels); 'epochs' the epoch start times in seconds, the epoch duration, and the values [band][channel][epoch] (connectivity: [band][epoch]); IBI features have no epochs. Channels in the order of inputs.channels.

64 Hz.recipe: synthetic_edf.make_signals('clean') (seed synthetic_edf.SEED) / 10 microvolts; bipolar channels = electrode differences in the order of CHANNELS; 64 Hz cases: every 4th sample (no filter); the first 'seconds' seconds; the missing-samples case sets NAN_RUNS to NaN (tests/neural_eeg_features_inputs.py)

256 Hz.recipe: synthetic_edf.make_signals('clean') (seed synthetic_edf.SEED) / 10 microvolts; bipolar channels = electrode differences in the order of CHANNELS; 64 Hz cases: every 4th sample (no filter); the first 'seconds' seconds; the missing-samples case sets NAN_RUNS to NaN (tests/neural_eeg_features_inputs.py)
